name: homePos
meaning: ground-snapped position at Init, updated by msg 9 arg 1; Reset returns here when in world

name: target
meaning: RemoteControlProps.TARGET via Scn_GetPropObject(record, 4): the robot (or other object) receiving msg 0x3F on/off

name: switchOnOff
meaning: raw RemoteControlProps.SWITCHONOFF (record+0x14). Nonzero → msg 0x17 answers 0x10 (HELD_REMOTE), zero → 0x12 (HELD_REMOTE_ALT). 0 in every level.
